dataset.name: SPL/NAC (SPL-PNL) Brain Atlas
dataset.citation: Halle M, Talos I-F, Jakab M, Makris N, Meier D, Wald L, Fischl B, Kikinis R. Multi-modality MRI-based Atlas of the Brain. Surgical Planning Laboratory, Brigham and Women’s Hospital; 2017.
dataset.licence: 3D Slicer License (Contribution and Software License Agreement v1.0), per the repository LICENSE.md
dataset.modified: This is a MODIFIED version of the atlas, not the original: meshes were decimated, quantised and re-encoded for display (see transforms).
dataset.intendedUse: Per the licence: designed for research purposes only; clinical applications are neither recommended nor advised.
dataset.subject: One healthy adult volunteer (single-subject MRI). Not a population average and not a clinical reference.
dataset.acknowledgement: NIH P41 EB015902, P41 RR013218, R01 MH050740; Google Research Grant (from the atlas README).

space.name: SPL/NAC subject space (scanner RAS)
space.notStandardised: This is NOT MNI / Talairach space. Coordinates are meaningful only within this subject’s atlas.
space.modelToLabelTransform: identity (slicer/transforms/LinearTransform_3.tfm); checked per structure in labelCheck

midSagittalPlane.model: x = a + b*y + c*z (RAS mm), least-squares fit to the midpoints of all left/right structure pairs
midSagittalPlane.note: The subject’s mid-sagittal plane is tilted relative to the scanner axes. A "sagittal" cut at constant R is a scanner-axis plane, not exactly this anatomical midline.

display.note: Viewer-only transform, never written back: three.js (x, y, z) = (R, S, −A) × 0.001 m/mm.
